gen-gf-inria-sans-fs-literata: Stout, uniform strokes and a wide-mouthed a give Inria Sans its friendly look. Literata, with mild thick-thin stress, sits beneath it and keeps every stroke solid, moving the page from friendly to bookish.
gen-gf-inria-serif-fs-bespoke-sans: Refined and traditional, Inria Serif swells gently on its curves. Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif with generous gaps where curves meet stems, would carry long paragraphs sharply and without strain.
gen-gf-intel-one-mono-fs-literata: Typewriter-tidy and loosely spaced, Intel One Mono lines up its letters like a row of fence posts beside Literata. Mechanical order against a bookish serif is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-iosevka-charon-fs-literata: Code-style and crisp, Iosevka Charon keeps every letter the same width. Charon's strokes never vary, so the moderate swell and shrink of Literata, a text serif, feels doubly bookish.
gen-gf-iosevka-charon-mono-fs-bespoke-sa: Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined, with generous gaps beside its stems. Iosevka Charon Mono draws fixed-width code-style letters in one flat fineliner line, and that technical precision is what the pairing is about.
gen-gf-italiana-fs-literata: Sturdy, bookish text with gently shifting strokes sets the reading mood. Literata does the steady reading work, while Italiana, with its hairline-topped bold a and sharp fat-to-fine swings, does the showing off.
gen-gf-kaisei-opti-fs-bespoke-sans: Heavy strokes snapping to hairlines: that's Kaisei Opti. Bespoke Sans, a sans that stays low in contrast with generous gaps by its stems, gives that editorial drama a quiet, sharp-edged counterweight.
gen-gf-lilex-fs-literata: Technical to the core, Lilex hangs fixed-width, code-style glyphs on long gaps, its c opened like a pair of calipers. Literata, a text serif, softens it with mild letterpress-like modulation.
gen-gf-livvic-fs-literata: Livvic holds one level line width through every letter, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals, a quiet start. Literata, a serif, adds only slightly heavier thick strokes beneath.
gen-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c-fs-literata: Open jaws on every curved stroke give M PLUS Rounded 1c its look. Literata, whose stroke weight shifts noticeably but never dramatically, would carry paragraphs with a bookish, sturdy rhythm.
